# Taqueria Sabrina

> Taqueria Sabrina is a Mexican food pop-up (taquería) based in Utrera, Spain — in the province of Seville, Andalusia. We serve authentic, freshly made Mexican tacos at pop-up events around the area.

## About

Taqueria Sabrina is a mobile taco stand bringing real Mexican street food — tacos — to Utrera and the surrounding Sevilla region of southern Spain. Everything is made fresh at each pop-up. We rotate a weekly selection of tacos and specials, including plant-based and vegetarian options.

Cuisine: Mexican food, tacos, Mexican street food (comida mexicana, tacos).
Location: Utrera, Sevilla, Andalucía, Spain.

## The deal

Tacos are priced as a bundle: 1 taco for €3, 2 tacos for €5, 3 tacos for €7.

## Menu

The taco menu changes week to week. Typical offerings include tacos such as Tortillero, Adobada, Tinga, and BBQ, plus à la carte specials like pinchitos and guacamole. Check the website or Instagram for the current menu, prices, next event date, and location.

## Contact

Follow @taqueriasabrina on Instagram for the latest pop-up dates and locations in Utrera and around Sevilla, Spain.
